name: mirage
text: Fair question. Last in line only holds when the better feeds answered: it is still asked for any game or book the others left a gap on, and that gap check repeated every 30 minutes per league and kind, which across ~8 leagues costs real credits for gaps that no feed fills. I changed that in v1.0.26: a gap is retried only every 3 hours (fallback because every better feed FAILED is unchanged and immediate), and the per-purpose spend log (hourly, in the engine log) will show exactly what is left, so I can cut any purpose another API already serves. Honest limit: I cannot see per-purpose spend from before today; the ledger only has totals (about 3,700 credits used across its keys this month, ~185 a day).
